summary: Iteration 2: All 3 new features (Cloudinary signed-upload, RSVP, Mail.ru newsletter send) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 16/16 PASS. Frontend Playwright covered: admin login, tab order (auctions, lots, artists, rsvps, newsletter, contact), FileUpload 503 error path on auction form, RSVP block on upcoming + hidden on past, admin RSVPs panel with filter/export, Newsletter Compose 503 path. EN/RU language switch works.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses window.confirm() — blocks programmatic flows and is not stylistically aligned with the rest of the brutalist UI. Consider a styled confirm modal.
Tab data-testid is 'admin-tab-contact' but visible label is 'MESSAGES' — minor inconsistency between key/label.

issues: React hydration warning: a <span> rendered as direct child of <option> via Emergent dev wrapper. Console spam only — not functional. Won't appear in production builds.

action_items: Optional: replace window.confirm() in NewsletterAdmin.send with a styled modal so the send flow is visually consistent and easier to script.
Optional: rename 'contact' admin tab key to 'messages' OR change visible label to 'CONTACT' for consistency.
Note: hydration warning around <option><span> is from Emergent's dev wrapper and harmless; ignore unless seen in prod build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Cloudinary 503 detail and SMTP 503 detail strings match spec ('Cloudinary not configured' / 'SMTP not configured'). Good.
server.py /api/cloudinary/signature uses 'regex=' kwarg — works on current FastAPI but is deprecated; future-proof with 'pattern=' for Pydantic v2.
server.py admin_delete_auction cascades to lots but intentionally NOT to RSVPs (verified). Good — historical RSVP data is preserved.
newsletter send: uses synchronous smtplib inside an async endpoint — for large subscriber lists this will block the event loop. Consider running _send_email in run_in_executor or a background task.
newsletter send: failures are returned in response 'failed' list but always returns 200 even on partial failure — acceptable but consider 207 Multi-Status semantics.
FileUpload.jsx: error path verified (503 on /api/cloudinary/signature surfaces 'Cloudinary not configured. Set ...' in upload-error-auctions). The fallback URL input is still usable. Good UX.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ auctions/RSVPs/subscribers via pytest + Playwright. Cleaned up at end. 1 stray TEST auction was deleted via direct API after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 complete. Pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers Cloudinary sig 503/auth, newsletter send 503/auth, RSVP create+filter+admin list+delete, RSVP-persist-after-auction-delete. For UI tests of newsletter Compose, REMEMBER to register 'dialog' handler — send() uses window.confirm. RSVP block hides on past auctions. CLOUDINARY_*, SMTP_* env vars must remain empty in iteration 2 to assert 503 path; if main agent fills them later, the unconfigured tests will need to be skipped or env reset.
